PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Relative file paths are resolved from this directory when it exists.

file.description: The one existing file to edit. A request edits exactly one file; use nodes for multiple positions in that file.

line_tolerance.description: Optional non-negative tolerance in logical lines for stale start_line/end_line values. The old_content block must still occur exactly once in the original file. When this value is greater than 0, the runtime may accept that unique match only when its complete range falls within the declared range expanded upward and downward by line_tolerance lines. The default 0 requires an exact range match.

no_apply.description: When true, run the complete structural and node-level simulation and return preview output without writing. The flag applies to the whole request.

nodes.description: Ordered edit request. Edit nodes use original file line numbers; the runtime sorts edit nodes by original start line before applying them and processes append nodes last.

id.description: Unique node identifier used in diagnostics and result output.

start_line.description: Original 1-based inclusive start line from the file before this request.

end_line.description: Original 1-based inclusive end line from the file before this request.

old_content.description: Complete original logical-line content for the range. It must occur exactly once in the original file and match the declared range.

new_content.description: Replacement logical-line content. An empty string deletes the original range.

id.description: Unique node identifier used in diagnostics and result output.

new_content.description: Content appended to the final file end after all edit nodes. Empty files are supported.
